input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-damages, early-termination or minimum-fee obligation payable by Clear Capital. Compensation (§ 3) is pure time-and-materials with no minimum commitment and no late-payment penalty or interest; termination (§ 6(a)/(b) and the duplicated § 7(c)) entitles the Contractor only to fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date, which is compensatory rather than a stipulated sum, and § 5 even relieves Company of any fee obligation on certain terminations. The mutual liability cap in § 7(a) limits, rather than creates, Company-payable damages. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is warranted. We note only that any Statement of Work should be checked to ensure it does not introduce a cancellation or minimum-hours fee, which would need to be capped at three months' fees under the fallback.
